title: Academic Writing — Refurbishing office chairs
description: Academic Task 1 visual report and Task 2 essay. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The diagram shows how used office chairs are refurbished before resale.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

items.label: Receive
items.detail: Chairs arrive from offices in mixed condition.

items.label: Inspect
items.detail: Frames are checked for cracks; unsafe frames are recycled.

items.label: Disassemble
items.detail: The seat, castors and upholstery are removed.

items.label: Restore
items.detail: Usable parts are cleaned and worn parts replaced.

items.label: Test and dispatch
items.detail: Height and stability are checked before the chair is packed.

tasks.prompt:
Should manufacturers pay for the collection and repair of the products they sell? Give reasons for your answer.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples.

Write at least 250 words.
